sample_groups.name: healthy adults
sample_groups.evidence: Twenty-four healthy adults (12 female; age 19-32 years) provided written consent.

experimental_tasks.name: Auditory lexical decision task
experimental_tasks.description: Participants classified spoken real words and pronounceable pseudowords with left and right button presses.
experimental_tasks.evidence: Participants heard spoken real words and pronounceable pseudowords.

key_outcomes: Real words greater than pseudowords activated left inferior frontal and temporal cortex.
